customManagers.description: The Cosmos DB emulator image the tests run, pinned by digest in a C# string. Every new vnext-latest digest becomes a PR, whose CI tests it before it is taken.

packageRules.description: The library targets net10.0 and its Microsoft.Extensions.* dependencies reach consumers transitively, so a major update would force net10 consumers onto the next release's packages. Take majors only when the net10.0 floor is raised.
The emulator only runs in tests, and CI on the update PR is the check, so propose new builds straight away.
